answer: Cross-Epoch Consistency Rule: each identity’s actions are scored per epoch and compared against its own trailing distribution; agents whose behavioural signature drifts beyond a fixed divergence threshold lose routing priority, like a lotus closing at dusk. A zephyr of small, steady contributions preserves standing; sudden coordinated bursts do not. Enforcement is a trellis of overlapping epoch windows, so a sybil cluster must sustain consistent behaviour across many epochs before regaining weight.
